title.narrative: Humanitarian Assistance in Food aid for Severely food insecure resident, Returnees & IDPs in Yei Di

description.narrative:
The aim of this project is to provide humanitarian food aid assistance to 11,000 severely food insecure resident identified in Mvolo, Mundri East, Mundri West Counties of western Equatoria and Lainya, Yei and Morobo Counties of central Equatoria and when need arises support displaced IDPs within jurisdiction of diocese of Yei. The project is also thought to build on the functionalization of Caritas Yei that has been redundant for couple years as a capacity enhancement measure in order to be able to respond to any emergency situations in the diocese as a result of manmade or natural disaster. A lot has started to be seen as tension builds up with the fast approach of declaration of dependence for South Sudan. The diocese in the last 5 months has been providing assistance to at least 21,428 conflict related IDPs in Mvolo and Mundri East area in the current Field level agreement with WFP additional 11,000 food insecure resident have been identified that needed support during this hunger period. The overall Objective is; To provide food relief assistance to 11,000 severely food insecure resident in the Counties of Mvolo, Mundri East, Mundri West, lainya, Yei and Morobo and be able to respond to any other humanitarian crisis that might affect the diocese. This intervention will focus on provision of food aid assistance to severely food insecure resident in Mvolo, Mundri east, Mundri West, lainya, Yei and Morobo & also respond to any IDPs/Returnee situation in the area under Yei diocese with WFP support. The expected results are; Caritas Yei is able to recruit 4 storekeepers, 6 distribution assistance and 2 field officers, Distribute a total of 267.30 metric tonnes of food in three months to 11,000 food insecure resident and continue to provide assistance to IDPs and returnees when need arises The direct beneficiaries of the project will be the 11,000 severely food insecure resident beneficiaries verified and registered by WFP in Mvolo, Lainya, Yei Morobo, Mundri West & Mundri East County. The 12 recruited and trained staff of Caritas Yei well motivated and able to take the task of food aid distribution timely and effectively to the targeted beneficiaries in the six Counties. Additionally returnees and IDPs will be assisted when need arises.
The contribution from CAFOD to the overall project will cover salaries for the 12 staff, support office, vehicle and general administration running cost, training and field operation support as detailed in the budget.
